approach: Static recompilation of the PowerPC code (with title update 2 applied) to x86-64, Direct3D 12 renderer

links.label: Based on FNC Reborn by Whompay

help: Testing on older and low-end PCs
notes: A fork of FNC Reborn built with title update 2. All DLC works offline: the Legends Pack (boxers, venues, Bare Knuckles Mode), Champion Mode boxers, boosts, XP packs and licensed gear. Raises the Legacy Mode skill level cap, adds a Settings > EXTRAS tab and restores instant replays. Built from your own disc, title update and DLC; the repository contains no game code or data.
